scripts.text:
[Mungmung]
I'm not the innkeeper!
Why do people want to pay me when they see me?
scripts.translation:
[汪汪]
我不是旅店老闆！
為什麼一看到我，大家就想付錢給我？

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
My pain is getting worse and worse
since the crevice appeared in Bifrost.
Are you responsible for it, young one?
scripts.translation:
[內姆內姆]
自從雙層牛肉堡出現裂縫以來，
我的痛苦越來越嚴重了。
是你造成的嗎，年輕人？

scripts.text: Of course I am!
scripts.translation: 當然是我！

scripts.text: That's an unfair accusation!
scripts.translation: 這真是無稽之談！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
Bra~vo!
scripts.translation:
[內姆內姆]
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Nemnem]
If not, never mind!
scripts.translation:
[內姆內姆]
如果不是，那就當我沒說！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation
was at its worst.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以當時的情況
已經糟糕到了極點。

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh~!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾斯]
噢~！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
Bored to death, I started to cry.
Then I fell asleep, tired from all the crying.
And when I woke up,
I was even more bored
than before!
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
我無聊得要死，於是開始哭泣。
然後因為哭得太累，我就睡著了。
等我醒來時，
我比之前更無聊了！

scripts.text:
[Raffles]
Oh, oh!
That's terrible, so terrible.
How could that happen?!
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾斯]
噢，噢！
太可怕了，太可怕了。
怎麼會發生這種事？！

scripts.text:
[Boaster]
So the situation got
more and more serious...
Now give me some more coins.
scripts.translation:
[吹牛的人]
所以情況變得
越來越嚴重了...
現在再給我一些硬幣吧。

scripts.text:
[Rangrang]
I've never heard such a boring and sad story.
I feel like crying!
scripts.translation:
[朗朗]
我從未聽過如此無聊又悲傷的故事。
我都想哭了！

scripts.text:
[A Decoy]
Oh~!
That's just so
unbelievable!
I'm so curious, let's give him some coins!
scripts.translation:
[誘餌]
噢~！
這簡直太不可思議了！
我很好奇，我們給他一些硬幣吧！

scripts.text:
[Moved Raffle]
This is sad, too sad!
I'm not sure why,
but it must be sad
because everybody else says so.
scripts.translation:
[感動的 拉弗爾]
這太悲傷了，太悲傷了！
我不確定為什麼，
但既然大家都這麼說，
那它一定很悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Wow~!
This is exciting.
He woke up safe and sound again!
Well, I'm sure he will next time!
...
scripts.translation:
[鬆了口氣的 拉弗爾]
哇~！
這真令人興奮。
他又安全地醒來了！
嗯，我相信下次也會如此！
...

scripts.text:
[Relieved Raffle]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[鬆了口氣的 拉弗爾]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Excited Raffle]
Wow~
The story is no fun at all.
Wow~!
But it's as if we were singing in chorus -
it's really fun.
Wow~!
scripts.translation:
[興奮的 拉弗爾]
哇~
這個故事一點都不有趣。
哇~！
但就像我們在合唱一樣——
真的很有趣。
哇~！

scripts.text:
[Impressed Raffle]
Wow! Wow!
scripts.translation:
[佩服的 拉弗爾]
哇！哇！

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
I'm stuck here because of the crevice, which appeared out of nowhere.
Ha......
scripts.translation:
[莫拉的訪客]
因為突然出現的裂縫，我被困在這裡了。
哈......

scripts.text:
[Visitor to Mora]
Isn't this one cheerful village?
With Bifrost blocked like that, I'm thinking of settling here permanently.
scripts.translation:
[莫拉的訪客]
這不是一個很快樂的村莊嗎？
既然雙層牛肉堡被堵住了，我正考慮在這裡定居下來。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I heard that somebody made it out of the Labyrinth Forest alive.
Whoever it is, I want to meet this person myself.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我聽說有人活著走出了迷宮森林。
不管是誰，我都想親自見見這個人。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷宮森林，成為英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我聽說已經有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我說那個人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
別開玩笑了。說我自己做到的還更可信一點。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，確實是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
I'll come out of the Labyrinth Forest and become a hero!
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
我要走出迷宮森林，成為英雄！

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
I hear somebody already did that.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
我聽說已經有人做到了。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
What if I say I'm that somebody?
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
如果我說那個人就是我呢？

scripts.text:
[Indifferent Worker]
Forget it. It's more believable
to say I did it.
scripts.translation:
[冷漠的工人]
別開玩笑了。說我自己做到的還更可信一點。

scripts.text:
[Novice Worker]
Well, that's true.
scripts.translation:
[新手工人]
嗯，確實是這樣。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Stay clear of the Labyrinth Forest.
Don't ever dream of peeking in out of curiosity.
Lots of travelers have gone missing after going there.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
離迷宮森林遠一點。
千萬別因為好奇就想去窺探。
很多旅行者進去之後就失蹤了。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
The public bath in the center of the village is a symbol of Mora Village.
scripts.translation:
[悠閒的大王花]
村莊中心的公共浴池是穆拉村的象徵。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
It's not just a simple puddle.
It has tremendous power
to heal wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠閒的大王花]
它不僅僅是一灘水。
它具有強大的治癒傷口的力量。

scripts.text:
[Relaxing Rafflesia]
Try walking in the bath
if you want to see for yourself.
It will slowly but surely heal your wounds.
scripts.translation:
[悠閒的大王花]
如果你想親眼見證，不妨走進浴池試試。
它會緩慢但確定地治癒你的傷口。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I want to climb the ladder,
but my legs are too short to do that.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗爾]
我想爬梯子，
但我的腿太短，爬不上去。

scripts.text:
[Shortffle]
I wonder who brought it here.
scripts.translation:
[矮拉弗爾]
不知道是誰把它搬到這裡來的。

scripts.text:
You see a Rafflesia
lost in reading.
scripts.translation:
你看到一朵草精
正沉浸在閱讀中。

scripts.text: See what he's reading.
scripts.translation: 看看他在讀什麼

scripts.text: Leave him alone.
scripts.translation: 別管他

scripts.text:
Curious about what he's reading,
you quietly approach him from behind.
The Rafflesia is reading in a low voice.
scripts.translation:
出於好奇，你悄悄從背後靠近他。
草精正低聲朗讀著。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren was going to Eremes's.
He was going there to borrow
Eremes's reference books,
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
塞蕾恩要去埃雷梅斯那裡。
他去那裡是為了借閱
埃雷梅斯的參考書，

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
but he also hoped to see
his beautiful sister, Seiren.
Seiren knocked on Eremes's door
with his heart pounding.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
但他也希望見到
他美麗的姐姐，塞蕾恩。
塞蕾恩心跳加速地
敲響了埃雷梅斯的門。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
Excuse me. Is anybody there?
... ... ...
He doesn't hear anything.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
咚！咚！咚！
打擾了。有人在家嗎？
... ... ...
他什麼也沒聽到。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Is there nobody home?
He knocked again,
afraid that he might have
made the trip for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
難道沒人嗎？
他又敲了一次，
擔心自己白跑一趟。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Knock! Knock! Knock!
No answer again. Is there nobody home?
He knew it was rude to do that,
but he decided to enter anyway
and wait for Eremes to come back home.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
咚！咚！咚！
還是沒人應聲。難道沒人嗎？
他知道這樣做很無禮，
但他還是決定進去，
等埃雷梅斯回來。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren opened the front door
with his heart throbbing.
*squeak*
The door wasn't locked.
Eremes seems to be away for a while.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
塞蕾恩心跳加速地打開了前門。
*吱呀*
門沒有鎖。
看來埃雷梅斯暫時不在家。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren entered the house hesitantly.
The moment he stepped into the house,
he heard a sound of water running.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
塞蕾恩猶豫地走進了屋子。
剛踏進屋內，
他就聽到了流水聲。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren suddenly came to his senses,
and turned back to go out.
But right at the moment!!
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
塞蕾恩突然回過神來，
轉身準備離開。
但就在那一瞬間！！

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*thud*
The bathroom door opened,
and with white steam pouring out came a foot.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
*砰*
浴室的門開了，
伴隨著噴湧而出的白色蒸汽，
伸出了一隻腳。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
Seiren's heart almost stopped
at the sight of it. And a moment later,
somebody came out from the bathroom,
with just a towel around her body.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
看到這一幕，塞蕾恩的心臟幾乎停跳。
片刻之後，
一個人從浴室裡走了出來，
身上只圍著一條毛巾。

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
With her body still wet
from the shower...
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
她的身體還溼漉漉的，
顯然剛洗完澡...

scripts.text:
[Reading Rafflesia]
*gasp* Who are you? How long
were you standing there? How rude.
scripts.translation:
[讀書的大王花]
*倒吸涼氣* 你是誰？
你在那裡站了多久？
太沒禮貌了。

scripts.text:
The Rafflesia closed the book hastily.
You're curious what will happen next,
but you've been rude enough,
so you just give up.
scripts.translation:
大王花匆忙合上了書。
你很好奇接下來會發生什麼，
但既然你已經夠失禮了，
只好就此作罷。

scripts.text:
You leave the place quietly
in order not to disturb
the Rafflesia, who was lost in reading.
scripts.translation:
為了不打擾沉浸在閱讀中的大王花，
你悄悄地離開了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
You want a banana?
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
你想要香蕉嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Take it if you can.
If you are successful, you can have it for free.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
如果你能拿到，就拿去吧。
如果你成功了，就可以免費擁有它。

scripts.text:
[Banana Rafflesia]
Well, I was going to give it for free,
but if you don't want it, it's fine with me.
scripts.translation:
[香蕉大王花]
嗯，我本來打算免費給你的，
但如果你不想要，那也沒關係。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Mora Inn is famous
for its unusual pieces of furniture.
Mushroom closets and apple dressers...
Aren't they so innovative?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉旅館以其獨特的傢俱而聞名。
蘑菇衣櫃和蘋果梳妝檯...
它們難道不很有創意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Sorry... maybe it's just me...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
抱歉...也許只是我覺得奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
The Rafflesia in Mora Village all look alike, so it's so confusing.
It's like looking at centuplets...
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
穆拉村的大王花長得都差不多，所以很容易混淆。
就像在看多胞胎一樣...

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
However! If you look closely,
you'll find each of them has a personality.
To find it is one of the fun things
you can do in the village.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不過！如果你仔細觀察，
會發現它們每個人都有獨特的個性。
發現這一點是你在村裡可以做的有趣事情之一。

scripts.text:
[Wounded Raffle]
Ugghh... What was it
that was in the bath... Arrrghh...
To attack suddenly like that... Be careful...
Whatever it is in there, it's very aggressive.
scripts.translation:
[受傷的拉弗爾]
嗚...剛才在浴室裡的是什麼...
啊...
突然襲擊...小心...
不管那是什麼，它非常具有攻擊性。

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The inn over there~
It should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
那邊的旅館~
本來應該是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The store over there~
It should've been mine as well~
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
那邊的商店~
本來也應該是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
The warehouse here~
and all the things in it~
All of those should've been mine~
All of those should've been mine~
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
這裡的倉庫~
還有裡面的所有東西~
本來都應該是我的~
本來都應該是我的~

scripts.text:
[Lively]
Ahhh... I'd like to make money...
scripts.translation:
[活潑]
啊...我想賺點錢...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Oh... this duck...
scripts.translation:
[庫奧裡塔]
噢...這隻鴨子...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
Its slender red beak...
and the blush on its cheeks...
and its wings, ready to take off
any moment...
scripts.translation:
[庫奧裡塔]
它細長的紅喙...
還有臉頰上的紅暈...
以及隨時準備起飛的翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Kuorita]
I want to have it badly...
What would happen if I stole it?
scripts.translation:
[庫奧裡塔]
我真的很想要它...
如果我把它偷走會怎樣？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
With a little token of appreciation, I will tell you a quote that will help you in your life.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
只要給我一點小費，我就送你一句能助你人生的名言。

scripts.text: Give him a token of appreciation.
scripts.translation: 給他一點小費

scripts.text: Can't you just tell me?
scripts.translation: 不能直接告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You don't get something for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
天下沒有免費的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
How much are you willing to give me?
You can pay me in the currencies listed below.
Enter the sum you're willing to pay. Enter 0 if you don't want to pay anything.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
你願意付多少錢？
你可以用下面列出的貨幣支付。
請輸入你願意支付的金額。如果不願支付，請輸入0。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you don't want to hear a quote, eh?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
所以，你不想聽名言，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
You can pay between ^FF0000100 and 1000000^000000.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
你可以支付 ^FF0000100 到 1000000^000000 之間的金額。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think this is what my time is worth?
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
所以，你覺得我的時間值這麼多錢？

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
The quote I'm going to tell you is...
Let's see... Wait a second.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
我要告訴你的名言是...
讓我想想...稍等一下。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
Okay! I think this is the one for you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
好了！我覺得這句最適合你。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Nothing is more difficult,
and therefore more precious,
than to be able to decide.
- Napoleon Bonaparte -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
沒有什麼比做出決定更難，
因此也更珍貴。
- 拿破崙·波拿巴 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Sometimes we stare so long at a door that is closing,
that we see too late the one that is open.
- Alexander Graham Bell -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
有時我們盯著即將關閉的門太久，
以至於太晚才發現那扇敞開的門。
- 亞歷山大·格拉漢姆·貝爾 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
If it's that painful, why do you keep doing it?
The answer's simple.
Because it makes my heart beat,
because it excites me.
My body might suffer, but I'm a lot happier
doing what I have always wanted to do.
- Biya Han -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
如果那麼痛苦，你為什麼還要繼續？
答案很簡單。
因為它讓我的心跳動，
因為它讓我興奮。
我的身體可能會受苦，但我做著自己一直想做的事，
我感到非常快樂。
- 韓 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
You cannot persuade anybody
before you change yourself.
- Cheoljong Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
在改變別人之前，
你必須先改變自己。
- 高宗 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Never regret what you have chosen.
- Miyoung Ko -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
不要後悔你所做出的選擇。
- 高美英 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
A man is not finished when he is defeated.
He is finished when he quits.
- Richard Nixon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
一個人只有在放棄的時候，
才算真正被擊敗。
- 理查德·尼克松 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Failure is instructive.
The person who really thinks
learns quite as much from his failures
as from his successes.
- John Dewey -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
失敗具有教育意義。

你不可能同時憤怒和大笑。
憤怒與歡笑互斥，
而你有選擇權。
- 韋恩·戴爾 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
We don't laugh because we're happy
- we're happy because we laugh.
- William James -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
我們不是因為快樂而笑，
而是因為笑才快樂。
- 威廉·詹姆斯 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The person who knows how to laugh at himself
will never cease to be amused.
- Shirley MacLaine -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
懂得自嘲的人，
永遠不會停止感到有趣。
- 雪莉·麥克雷恩 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The young man who has not wept is a savage,
and the older man who will not laugh is a fool.
- George Santayana -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
未曾哭泣的年輕人是野蠻人，
不願大笑的老年人是傻瓜。
- 喬治·桑塔亞那 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
I do not have much patience
with a thing of beauty
that must be explained
to be understood.
If it does need additional interpretation
then I question
whether it has fulfilled its purpose.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
我對那些必須被解釋才能被理解的美，
缺乏耐心。
如果它需要額外的解讀，
我就懷疑它是否實現了它的目的。
- 查理·卓別林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Life is a tragedy
when seen in close-up,
but a comedy
in long-shot.
- Charlie Chaplin -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
近距離看，生活是一場悲劇；
遠距離看，生活是一場喜劇。
- 查理·卓別林 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The clearest sign of wisdom is continued cheerfulness.
- Michel de Montaigne -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
智慧最明顯的標誌是持續的愉悅。
- 米歇爾·德·蒙田 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
The time you enjoyed wasting
was not wasted.
- John Lennon -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
你享受浪費的時間，
並沒有被浪費。
- 約翰·列儂 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
True humor springs not more from the head than from the heart.
It is not contempt; its essence is love.
It issues not in laughter,
but in still smiles, which lie far deeper.
- Thomas Carlyle -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
真正的幽默，
不僅源於頭腦，更源於心靈。
它不是蔑視，其本質是愛。
它不表現為大笑，
而是更深層的靜默微笑。
- 托馬斯·卡萊爾 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
Through humor, you can soften
some of the worst blows
that life delivers.
And once you find laughter,
no matter how painful
your situation might be,
you can survive it.
- Bill Cosby -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
通過幽默，
你可以軟化生活中最沉重的打擊。
一旦你找到了笑聲，
無論處境多麼痛苦，
你都能生存下去。
- 比爾·科斯比 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
{0}, the quote I'm going to tell you is...
My great hope is to laugh
as much as I cry;
to get my work done
and try to love somebody
and have the courage
to accept the love in return.
- Maya Angelou -
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
{0}，我要告訴你的名言是...
我最大的希望是，
能像哭泣一樣多笑；
完成我的工作，
試著去愛某人，
並有勇氣接受回報的愛。
- 瑪雅·安吉洛 -

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
People take what they hear
differently.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
人們對自己聽到的話，
理解各不相同。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
I wonder what you think
about what I've told you.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
我想知道，
你對我剛才說的話怎麼看。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
So you think that {0}.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
所以你認為{0}。

scripts.text:
[Raffle Philosopher]
... ... ... ...

[Raffle Philosopher]
I don't know. There is no one answer
to this question...
Hold onto your thought.
scripts.translation:
[拉弗爾哲人]
我不知道。這個問題沒有唯一的答案...
請堅守你的想法。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you dare play a game with me?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
你...你竟敢跟我玩這種把戲？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
What...? Do you have proof?
Do you have proof?!!
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
什...什麼？你有證據嗎？
你有證據嗎？！！

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Look, stop it, just stop it!
I'm afraid it will turn into a big fight...
scripts.translation:
[勸架的旅行者]
喂，別吵了，快停下！
我怕這會演變成一場大斗毆...

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
Oh! Why don't we ask
that person there...?
scripts.translation:
[勸架的旅行者]
噢！我們要不問問那邊那個人...？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
Oh, yes! That's a great idea.
Well~ Hello there~
You there, traveler!
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
噢，對！這是個好主意。
嘿~你好呀~
那邊那位，旅行者！

scripts.text: They seem to be calling out to you.
scripts.translation: 他們似乎正在向你呼喊。

scripts.text: See what the matter is.
scripts.translation: 看看發生了什麼事

scripts.text: I have nothing to do with it.
scripts.translation: 我與此事無關

scripts.text:
You went on your way
leaving the travelers behind you.
scripts.translation: 你離開了那些旅行者，繼續前行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's happening here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
I'll tell you what.
Rose's mother had 10 sons.
The eldest son is called Roseone,
the second Rosetwo,
the third Rosethree...
the ninth Rosenine...
you get how it works, right?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
我來告訴你。
蘿絲的母親有10個兒子。
大兒子叫Roseone，
二兒子叫Rosetwo，
三兒子叫Rosethree...
九兒子叫Rosenine...
你明白其中的規律了吧？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
Right, that's how it works.
So I asked what the youngest one would be called,
and when I told him the answer,
he got all upset and started cursing me.
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
對，就是這樣的規律。
所以我問最小的那個叫什麼，
當我告訴他答案時，
他非常生氣，開始罵我。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You... you bastard!
Hey there, what do you think
the answer to the question is?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
你...你這個混蛋！
喂，你覺得這個問題的答案是什麼？

scripts.text: Roseten.
scripts.translation: Roseten

scripts.text: Rose.
scripts.translation: Rose

scripts.text: How would I know that?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼知道？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Roseten.
Why are you fighting over such a trivial matter?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個問題的答案是Roseten。
你們為什麼要在這麼瑣碎的事情上爭吵？

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
See? Even this traveler says
Roseten is the answer.
How dare you try to play tricks on me?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
看吧？連這位旅行者都說
Roseten是答案。
你竟敢耍我？

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
You idiot... you don't have the slightest clue!
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
你這個笨蛋...你完全不懂！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The answer to the question is Rose.
You said Rose's mother had 10 sons.
So even if the other sons' names are
Roseone, Rosetwo, ... Rosenine,
the youngest one must be Rose,
or she wouldn't be called Rose's mother.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個問題的答案是Rose。
你說蘿絲的母親有10個兒子。
所以即使其他兒子的名字是
Roseone, Rosetwo, ... Rosenine，
最小的那個一定是Rose，
否則她就不會被稱為蘿絲的母親。

scripts.text:
[Traveler That Posed the Question]
That's exactly what I mean!
I can't hang around with him.
I guess we live in two different worlds.
scripts.translation:
[提問的旅行者]
我說的就是這個意思！
我沒法和他這種人待在一起。
看來我們生活在兩個不同的世界。

scripts.text:
[Upset Traveler]
You bastard... What did you
get from this guy...?
scripts.translation:
[心煩的旅行者]
你這個混蛋...你從這傢伙那裡
得到了什麼好處...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have no idea.
Try to sort it out yourselves.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我完全不知道。
你們自己解決吧。

scripts.text:
[Traveler Trying to Stop the Fight]
You good-for-nothing bastard,
you're trying to leave this mess to me?
scripts.translation:
[勸架的旅行者]
你這個沒用的混蛋，
你想把這爛攤子留給我？

scripts.text:
*thud*
You feel a sudden impact on the back of your head.
Your sight is going blurry.
scripts.translation:
*砰*
你感到後腦勺突然受到撞擊。
你的視線開始模糊。

scripts.text: You feel somebody rummaging through your pockets before you pass out.
scripts.translation: 在你失去意識之前，你感覺到有人在翻你的口袋。

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew~ Phew~
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呼~ 呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snore...
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
哼--

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Snort--
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
哼--

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Moan...
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
嗚...

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
Phew phew pheeew~
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
呼~ 呼~ 呼~

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
茲 茲

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
茲 茲

scripts.text:
[Mora Villager]
z Z
scripts.translation:
[莫拉村民]
茲 茲

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh~ looks like we have another adventurer.
Where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哦~看來又來了一位冒險者。
您是從哪裡來的？

scripts.text: Just save the game.
scripts.translation: 儲存遊戲

scripts.text: I'd like to get some rest.
scripts.translation: 我想休息一下

scripts.text: The place I used to live is called...
scripts.translation: 我以前住的地方叫...

scripts.text: How can I use the warehouse?
scripts.translation: 如何使用倉庫？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Wow, what's the rush?
You've just come here, and you're already going someplace else?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哇，這麼急嗎？
你剛來這裡，就要去別的地方了？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
You know, haste makes waste. Tsk tsk.
Well, the game's been saved.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
俗話說，欲速則不達。嘖，嘖。
好了，遊戲已經儲存了。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
My my, I need some rest also.
The rate is 5000 zeny. Do you want a room?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哎呀，我也需要休息一下。
房費是5000 Zeny。您想住一間房嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
The rate is 5000z.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
房費是5000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Make yourself at home.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
請自便。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
If you don't have the money, go soak yourself in the puddle in the center of the village.
It will warm you up.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
如果您沒有錢，就去村中央的水坑裡泡一泡吧。
那樣會暖和一點。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I come from a place called {1}.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我來自一個叫{1}的地方。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Oh, I think I've heard about the place before!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
哦，我想我以前聽說過那個地方！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard there's an old tower where horrible witches put Savages in a giant cauldron and cast evil spells on them, right?
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
我聽說那裡有一座古老的塔，可怕的巫師們把野豬放進巨大的鍋裡，並對它們施放惡之魔力，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
What's worse is that whoever takes medicine made out of Savages will come back for more!
And he will wander around looking for the tower, and eventually turn into an enormous Savage!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
更糟糕的是，吃了用野豬做的藥的人還會想要更多！
他們會四處遊蕩尋找那座塔，最終變成巨大的野豬！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I heard that there are creeps there who won't get up at all even if it rains or snows, or their sweethearts or parents call them!
And that black clouds hover over them all the time, causing a storm!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
我聽說那裡有一些傢伙，無論下雨下雪，或者他們的戀人或父母叫他們，他們都不會起床！
而且烏雲總是懸停在他們的頭頂，引發風暴！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
How terrible!
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Search through the vegetable-shaped drawer to my right.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老闆]
請翻找我右邊那個蔬菜形狀的抽屜。

scripts.text: - You don't remember how to open the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你不記得怎麼開啟倉庫了。 -

scripts.text: - The figure 1 0 0 is written in small letters on the vegetable-shaped drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 蔬菜形狀的抽屜上用很小的字寫著數字 1 0 0。 -

scripts.text: Insert 100 zeny.
scripts.translation: 投入100 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't do anything.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不做

scripts.text: - You don't seem to have 100 zeny with you. -
scripts.translation: - 你身上似乎沒有100 Zeny。 -

scripts.text: - You gave up using the warehouse. -
scripts.translation: - 你放棄了使用倉庫。 -
